description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest' for testing the 'EmployeeReportingMethodDao' class within the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover CRUD operations and search functionalities related to employee reporting relationships, including supervisor/subordinate retrieval, counting, and deletion.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeReportingMethodDao's methods related to employee reporting structures within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reporting relationship when the report-to data is available.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval returning null when no report-to relationship exists for given employees.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting of subordinates for an employee when subordinates exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting when no subordinates are found.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting immediate supervisors for an employee when they exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting immediate supervisors when none are found.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors returns an empty array if none are available.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors with existing relationships, verifying the supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of subordinates for an employee, verifying subordinate details and reporting methods.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests that searching for subordinates returns an empty array when none are found.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSupervisor
methods.description: Tests saving a supervisor reporting relationship for an employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSubordinate
methods.description: Tests saving a subordinate reporting relationship for an employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Tests deletion of supervisor relationships for a specific employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Tests deletion of subordinate relationships for a specific employee.
